definitions.explanation: A category or class of people or things grouped by shared characteristics. Often used in the pattern ～の部類に入る to say something belongs to a certain category.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{部類|ぶるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: That falls into the expensive category.
He is in the tall category.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国的|ぜんこくてき}→全国的：20017_zenkokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧{部類|ぶるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think this shop's ramen ranks among the tasty ones even on a national level.

notes:
Most commonly appears in the pattern ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部類|ぶるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to fall into the category of ~). Used to classify something relative to others of its kind.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部類|ぶるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to belong to the ~ category)
- ～{部類|ぶるい}だ (is in the ~ group)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部類|ぶるい} (the upper category)
- ⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧{部類|ぶるい} (the rare category)
- ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な{部類|ぶるい} (the excellent category)
